sentences.text: You meet people for your job.
A network is a group of people.
This network is important for your work.
They help you find a job.
They help you learn new things.
You use a computer or a phone.
LinkedIn is a website for jobs.
On the website, you have a profile.
A profile is a page about you.
Your profile is for other people.
You are now in a network.
It is good to have many connections.
Many connections are many new friends for work.

questions.text: What do you say to new people?
What do you have on the website?
